entities.summary: P. Chaudhary is an Indian senior advocate and politician who has served as a Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha, representing Pali constituency in Rajasthan since 2014. Previously, he had served as a Minister of State for Corporate Affairs, Law and Justice, and Electronics and Information Technology. He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
